species. The Boron atom of the BCI, is short of two electrons to complete its
octet. An addition compound is formed when the Nitrogen of NH, donates
this lone pair of electron to the Boron of BCI, which accepts it and forms the
addition compound.

(ii) Polar covalent bond
The covalent bond which is formed by the mutual sharing of electror
between atom, having different electronegativities is called polar covalent
bond.
Consider the ‘HCI’ molecule. There is single covalent bond between 'H' anc
‘Cl’ atoms. As the electronegativity of Chlorine atom is greater than the
electronegativity of Hydrogen atom. Therefore, the shared pair of electrons
between 'H' and 'Cl' atoms is attracted more towards ‘Cl’ than Hydrogen
atom. Hence, a partial positive charge is produced on Hydrogen atom anda
